verdicts.title: Feature Unification in TAG Derivation Trees
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The derivation trees of a tree adjoining grammar provide a first insight into the sentence semantics, and are thus prime targets for generation systems. We define a formalism, feature-based regular tree grammars, and a translation from feature based tree adjoining grammars into this new formalism. The translation preserves the derivation structures of the original grammar, and accounts for feature unification.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses tree adjoining grammars and feature unification in derivation trees for natural language generation, which has no interaction with geometric arithmetical rank or DPLL search tree width for CNF formulas.

verdicts.title: Generalized chip firing and critical groups of arithmetical structures on trees
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Chip firing provides a way to study the sandpile group (also known as the Jacobian) of a graph. We use a generalized version of chip firing to bound the number of invariant factors of the critical group of an arithmetical structure on a graph. We also show that, under suitable hypotheses, critical groups are additive under wedge sums of graphs with arithmetical structures.
